selector.rationale: Intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo and a mixed cell infiltrate are consistent with mucocutaneous leishmaniasis, which best explains the decisive findings without contradiction.

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: Contradicted by negative fungal culture and lack of specific Histoplasma antigens

rejected.label: Mucormycosis
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic hyphae and negative fungal culture

rejected.label: Oral ulcerative lesions
rejected.why: Too broad and nonspecific, does not account for the granulomatous reaction and intracellular yeasts

rejected.label: Chronic granulomatous disease
rejected.why: Although it has a high score, the presence of intracellular yeasts and the clinical presentation are more specific for mucocutaneous leishmaniasis
